geral.4,1: Some things to keep in mind while playing Akali
geral.5,1: This champion is extremely early/midgame focused. you have to do well early and put your lead on your team to win games
geral.6,1: You don't have heavy loosing lane matchups mostly. champions are more "thematically" countering you, and making your
geral.7,1: life a living hell. a great example is galio, who you might be able to solokill once or twice if they aren't playing super well
geral.8,1: but you will have a hard time playing the game in every single fight because of his W in your shroud and his ult in
geral.10,1: Akali's biggest cap: being an energy champion. she is a very unique champion in that she is gated by energy, which you
geral.11,1: can't increase in any way outside of getting bluebuff. this means that high hp and magic resist targets will always be a pain
geral.12,1: to deal with, unless you are extremely fed,
geral.13,1: When is Akali strong in a draft? good generic indicators are being solo or max duo AP ( don't consider supports as too much
geral.14,1: AP, but at the same time take into account that enemy team will build more mercurys treads the more CC you have which
geral.15,1: will give them MR despite them not building against magic damage that heavily.
geral.16,1: And when enemy is rather squishy. Champions that have a hard time fitting a ruby crystal or a nullmagic mantle into their
geral.17,1: builds even at 2-3 items are the best for Akali to play against.
geral.18,1: Wincondition? Playing for drakes is the most straight forward easiest Akali wincondition. i know it sounds a bit weird
geral.19,1: but since Akali can't hit epic monsters or towers by herself to great effectiveness, her best way to win and close out
geral.20,1: games is by carrying thoose dragon fights, making sure you get to soul, and then you just overpower most champions
geral.21,1: in the game. This doesn't mean you should overforce every drakefight, be a bit flexible! but most of your wins will come by
geral.22,1: this being your main approach, since most champions outscale you  in 30+minute games, but soul makes you keep up

and you don't, so basically if you trade ult for ult

help then you can 100-0 her if she is slightly

so its rather long, so try to get in a trade if you

better timers, otherwise really just anytime

but even then its hard with her W, and if you are
 below 50%hp you should never try to kill, you will

ing central.

mid.observar:

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:

mid.timers:

mid.observar:

healing reduction bad to buy, play around ignite.
mid.observar:

mid.timers:

-Anytime you dodge his E you can get great trades
and allin at around 60%hp as long as your ignite
is up.

mid.observar:
-Taking raw sylas E when your boneplating is not up
-Letting him raw W you without having to E
-using ignite before he uses his w in an allin
-Getting poked down too much by his Qs explosion part

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:

mid.observar:
-Can't let her keep poking you, need to trade back constantly
-Her E is insanely annoying to deal with, but mainly in teamfights,
1v1s less so.
-Her first ult she can use in combat and get out of your allin. but most

ult.

-E and phaserush are the 2 things to play around,
otherwise allin 0-24 if you can get in range and have
your ult up.

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:
-Perma ping roams, especially if your jgler is invading a lot, might
need to follow if he doesn't listen, but talon will always be first.
-He is supposed to be weak because he is supposed to be behind.
if even ofc he can fight back, don't underestimate his damage ever
mid.timers:
-His ult is lower cd than yours always, but his ult
is not super impactful. No real timers outside of LVL2
there you might need to respect a bit more.

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:

-She is scaling extremely hard, so make sure you get a lead from lvl5-10

-Level2-3 don't get allined by her, if you are too far up
the lane she might try to chase you down and chunk 
you a lot and it can be hard to come back from.
-Her ult is low cd early high late, so midgame catches
can be easier on her on sidelanes.

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:
-His ult is just a reveal for free for fun, and his range with rapid fire
is insanely high, but you need to play around it.
-On lane avoid getting hit by Qs while he is Qing the wave, atleast don't
take free poke.
-Always ping his potential ult plays, can ward on lane to know if he is
looking top or bot.
mid.timers:
-cleanse CD and his ult CD are the ones to play 
around, if you don't play cleanse its only ult. its high
CD but it lasts forever especially after lvl11, hard
to avoid fighting while its on.

mid.observar:
-His cage
-His item builds, some veigars like to go full AP some go very tanky,
and this is what it depends on if you just need to dodge 1Q and nuke
him or if you need to slowplay, doesn't matter as much if you get hit
but need to stick on him.
mid.timers:
-its all about his cage, 20s cd early on, which is very
long, but not longer than your W/E. just need to bait
it before wanting to allin, and just don't panic  when 
you are in it. you have plenty of space to dodge 
around.

mid.fazer:

mid.observar:

-Make sure you have W or E to get out of his Q ult poke asap, if not

-When he is hitting the wave its time to hit him.
-Flash timers are extremely important, both yours

-lategame pay attention to what teammate she hits with her ult

-Whenever her fear is down, i know it gets annoying
but it really is 80% of the champion. whenever you 
have cleanse she is 100to0able if you just insta
cleanse the fear.

mid.observar:
-His Q is more important to look out than E, as E is undodgeable and 
is way more about missing, but his Q auto combos are more play 
aroundable, and his shield especially from the Q

mid.fazer:

-Need to get a lead by lvl7 max, otherwise you are gettting outscaled a lot, and it will get harder and harder to find allin

mid.observar:
-He gets bonus MS while having his red empowered Q, make sure 
you keep that in mind and don't give that bonus healing and dmg 
for free.
-his W heals and slows a lot, very important to not stand in it and 
don't let him use it agressively by mispositioning.
mid.timers:
-Ignite ignite ignite
-Vlad W cd is rather high early. if you have ignite up
he is very allinable everytime W is on cd. 
-His W cd goes down a lot in midgame, it will be 
surprisingly low cd.

mid.observar:
-Getting too poked down to the point its scary to walk up
-His roams with ults, its important if he tries to walk up or down river 
for an ult threaten killing him, and with that you cancel his ult aswell
which your sidelaners will be thankful for!
mid.timers: -flash timers, both yours and his

mid.fazer:

-fighting without minions near is much easier.
this is more of a generic skillmatchup than it is yasuo specific, moving well is an extremely big thing as Akali in this matchup.
mid.observar:
-Missing Qs by not understanding where he is going to dash. if you 
watch/play/play against Yasuo a lot you will have a fairly predictable 
pattern in your head for where he wants to dash.Otherwise just try to
Q him whenever he is in dash animation.
mid.timers:
-Whenever his windwall is down its a lot easier and 
simpler, whenever there is nothing for him to dash
on he is a free kill.

mid.fazer:
-Constantly Q auto trade him, don't use E for trades unless its an allin, otherwise its a more of a disengage tool when
he tries to trade back with E-> Q+w or 3rd Q. so unless allin use it as that.
-don't longtade, he will run you down, either short trade or allin.
-Don't take free W poke and try to not use your combo into his W shield. if you can just wait around in shroud while 
shield is on him. he gets a way bigger shield if he hits champs than if he only hits minions.
-Similar to yasuo except easier because no windwall.
mid.observar:
-His tradebacks are the most important to learn to disengage from. 
If you learn when and how to it will be a lot easier.
-Stacked lethal tempo
mid.timers:
-no specific timer, you generally win till 3-4 items
and even then you have a decent outplay potential

mid.fazer:
-He is one of thoose matchups, just like Yasuo and Ambessa, where he might be a bit unpredictable so he is rather 
hard to play against the lower you go, this "Akali favoured" is mostly diamond+ label.
-Important to not get hit by raw Qs, need to only get hit by them if you are you behind minions, but preferably not

-Eing him after he ults works if he doesn't already have a shadow down, else he gets to insta w away and you will not
be able to trade back at all. 
-He is heavily outscaling in a teamfight setting, but you always have a chace to 1v1 on side, Zed will mostly be able
to run away tho.
mid.observar:
-His W shadow being down already before ulting you, then you can't
E him as he appears out of his ult behind you
-He might try this Zed99 trick where when he is low hp, goes into fog
of war under tower, comes back out, he will be missing some energy
because he put a shadow down under his own turret, gets hit by your
E on purpose and brings you into tower if you try to E2 him.
look out for his energy bar.
mid.timers:
-He always has a better allin window as his ult is 
always lower CD, so make sure if you use it at the same 
time you don't overtrade in the 10-20second window
as your ult is barely not up yet.

mid.fazer:
-Ziggs is insanely hard to get in range of. similar to xerath but with better disengage/less stationary. His Qs are rather
easy to dodge, so keep yourself atleast even and then you will be able to find e minion q champion e back trades, 
and if you do that 2-3 times at lvl7 you will be able to even dive him, but once again canon wave mostly needed else he
clears the wave way too fast.
-Later on sidelaning becomes a big problem for him, so don't stress super hard about getting a lead. Going even and then
playing fights/skirmishes well against him is rather common.
mid.observar:
-Overroaming/giving him free time with your turrets. fastest tower taking
champion in the game, very similar to diana can't let them hit tower.
mid.timers:
-Flash timers both of yours are important, just like 
many of theese mages you can flash ult them if
they are overxtanding, and get a free allin from full hp.

mid.fazer:
-Very hard to kill him in a 1v1, not an uber thematic counter, but gets very hard to play against. His bombs explode when
the target gets killed, so make sure you keep this in mind if he Qs a minion be it his own, or yours.
-You will go up 20-40cs etc, but don't throw it in 1v1, instead try to go for skirmishes
-Mercs is fake vs him, tenacity shard is not bad, but mercs is not good unless its good against enemy team as a whole.
mid.observar:
-His ult CD is basically non existant. literally 0, so trading ults is very
 bad
-playing 1v1s is mostly pointless, unless the zilean is really bad.
-It gets much worse and much more annoying, so need to try to
build a wincondition through drakes/getting a huge lead elsewhere.
mid.timers: -no timers

mid.fazer:
-Very hard to live against in earlygame, need to dodge every single E.
-Cleanse is very good in this matchup, might be mandatory the more i play it. but in lower ranks especially mercs+tenacity
shard should be completely fine. but one of them is needed 100%.
-When she is ulting she is stationary so try to hit an E on her there and then go for allins
-Slow trades, need to trade back consistently else you get poked out, but can't overtrade else you end up getting oneshot.
mid.observar:
-Es over walls once she pushed the wave  she could be fishing from
either side
-whatever she gets from bubble minions
-when you use a summ she is very likely to also pick it up and use it.
mid.timers:
-Earlygame there aren't really timers, just whenever
you can poke her down a bit and you are not super
low to get oneshot by her is time to hard trade on her.

top.fazer:
-Important to never get hit by sweetspots, usually good trading consists of dodging first Q, Q2 he Es you E it out and you
don't take E2 because he has Q3, this is a very common pattern, you can never E2 when he has Q3 up, never worth it,
The only way is dodging it with R1, but if he catches you mid R1 you are going to hardloose trade and loose ur ult.
-He is constantly outscaling you, so best to get a lead from lvl5-9, at 2-3 items nowdays he feels extremely unkillable.
-The line is extremely thin between killing him and him surviving with a lot of HP, one two Qs being dodged matters a lot.
allin from 60-70%hp extremely possible especially if you have ignite up.
top.observar:
-his sweetspots, much rather get hit by the inside of the spell if you
are bound to get hit by some part of it, so learning when its good to
walk into the spell and when its better to E out etc is also a big skill
to learn.
-His W reveals you, but extremely easy to get out of it.
top.timers:
-his ult is lower cd than yours.
-his Q cd is extremely important
-Ignite is the most important to play around, especially
the later the game goes, since you do need healing
reduction to kill him ALMOST always.

top.fazer:
-Will just inherently always be really annoying to 1v1 this champion, even if its a jungler as it has an insane amount 
of non telegraphed dashes and especially the lower rank you are the more annoyed you will get by this champ, you 
get better at reading it if you are really good but impossible to always do it, and Akali is not great vs anything with a lot of
mobility, as loosing a single Q is a massive DPS loss, let alone if she dodges multiple or E on top of it.
-her W is the most important spell to play around, but also her CDs overall in earlygame are rather high, so that is where
we need to capitalize and get some kind of lead, usually before first item completion. her lvl2-3 is kinda strong, lvl4 onwards
you should be winning.
top.observar:
-her earlygame CDs being high
-Her ult is a reveal but rather hard to hit on a champion like Akali, also
you can hide in front of a champion because it only lands on the last 
person in the line.
-can't be trading into her W, make sure you max hit 1 Q into it, never
proc your electro into it.
top.timers:
-no real timers, her ult cd is same as yours most
of the game, just need a lead before first item.
-the later the game is the more you need to play around
having healing reduction vs her because of her ult
passive. earlygame its close to not needed at all, late
game becomes unkillable without it.

top.fazer:
-very important to not give her free Ws on the outer edge, its a lot of healing and a shitton of damage.
-Her passive shield is massive, can't trade into it, need to get them to proc in and then stall.
-her E is very telegraphed, need to either E her if you can as she is flying at you ,or atleast W instantly so she doesn't get to

Tenacity shard really good in combination with mercs, so if its a mercs game go for it, take scaling HP from middle and always adaptive on top.
MS shard is good in matchups where you don't need the adaptive damage or the tenacity shard( can't take ms+tenacity imo, i always like 1 HP shard atleast for combat)

aba2.23,0:
FLAT HP VS SCALING HP:
If you ask me Scaling Hp always. pro players like to take scaling hp, and high elo players, but unless you are one of thoose you should be completely fine with scaling HP
earlygame, and you will be scaling a lot better into the mid/lategame without getting oneshot as much. Also the combination of scaling HP and overgrowth gives around 300+
HP midgame, which is almost as much as what rocketbelt gave you, so you effectively have that tankiness while building full dmg, and thats without calculating in gunblades 
healings effective health. The lower rank you are the longer your games are on average statistically, so please believe me, scaling HP is the way to go, flat HP is a scam.
